goal: AUDIT+FIX neon batch in html/ sources (kouzi/neonbreaker, neoninvaders, neonracer, neonsnake, neonvoidrunner + orbitaldrift + overtake): camera/screen-relative movement per game + drone/mute/stop audio per spec. N/A with reason where a game has no avatar/drone. MOVEMENT SPEC (camera-true): three.js camera rotation.y=yaw faces forward=(-sin yaw,-cos yaw), right=(cos yaw,-sin yaw) in world x/z. W (moveZ=-1) must move along forward; D (moveX=+1) along right. GG3D root cause is mirrored trig vx=(nx*cos-nz*sin),vy=(nx*sin+nz*cos) which must become vx=(nx*cos+nz*sin),vy=(-nx*sin+nz*cos). Verify at yaw 0,+/-90,180 deg with a scratch node calculation (no file committed). Derive per-game from its camera convention; do not blindly copy. AUDIO SPEC (no-buzz): (1) no endless raw drone - ambient beds must be musical (slow attack, tremolo/LFO or sequenced) and quiet (<=0.1); (2) live mute - setMuted/toggleMute must silence output immediately (store gain nodes, apply on change); (3) stop paths - stop()+disconnect()+null on game-over/abandon/menu/hub; (4) restart guard - playing flag + ctx check, never stack oscillators; (5) SFX one-shots with decay envelopes are fine, keep playSfx hook shapes unchanged. SOURCE RULE: public/games/html/ is source of truth; sync-game-bundles.mjs rm+copies it into public/games/<slug>/ (generated). NEVER write under public/games/<slug>/, never old-v1/, never shared manifests. Re-read each target before first write. node --check every touched file.
